text:
alex: Afternoon all, quick async standup — GPU headroom + quota ask for us-west1. TL;DR: want to prewarm 20 GPUs (15 on-demand, 5 spot fallback), migrate 2 nodePools off spot to reduce evictions.

 tanya: What's current spare count? Last snapshot showed ~18 free but 12 pinned for Dedicated.

 alex: Ran `fleetctl headroom --region=us-west1`. Output: free=16, reserved=12, warming=8. Opening cloud quota ticket CI-812 now.

 praveen: Can we split prewarm across AZs? Spots are flakey in us-west1-c today :thinking_face: 

 alex: Good call. Plan: 10 in us-west1-a (on-demand), 5 in -b (on-demand), 5 in -c (spot) as fallback. Avoid spot for the canary pool.

 sam: Blocker — model-x quantized build failed on prod image, jobs piling. PR #412 needs review before can rollout :grimacing:

 tanya: I'll do PR review in 10. Also recommend lowering autoscaler scale-up cooldown from 300s -> 120s for this burst.

 alex: Thanks — @tanya please open follow-up PR for cooldown. I'm kicking the quota request and will tag 5 gpus with `canary=true`.

 ops-bot: Started prewarm job id=prewarm-3265 (eta ~8m). Logs -> https://ci.redwood/integrations/prewarm/3265 :rocket:

 alex: ok, check back later; if anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
